sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: The owner, 2026-10-30: "Our relationship strength is something that dreams will play a big role in. When they find the same storyline in different vignettes they will have stronger dreams." This answers part of the affirmation thread's question "What makes a relationship strong?", which now carries recurrence as option E, and connects to confidence built from cross-checks (c8b12a7b). Today the synthesiser's weekly job (0e366cfd) names clusters, the nearest thing to finding storylines, and nothing records recurrence.
